title: Equality of spectral sparsities
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$. The number of nonzero vector Fourier coefficients of $f$ equals the number of nonzero Fourier coefficients indexed by linear functionals on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$.
hypotheses_covered: The ambient vector space $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ is finite-dimensional over $\mathbb{F}_2$
